knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A loose roof item is observed from the ground, access is controlled below, and a competent roofing trade is referred. Climbing or fixing is not appropriate for this role.
A visual inspection supports only a statement of what was seen and what was not inspected.
The lesson says not to push, lean on, or test a balustrade, wall or structure to see how it moves.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated facade with a crack and a loose fixing, the worker records both from the ground without climbing or testing.
The worker writes a referral that states what was seen and what was not inspected.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: The access needed to inspect requires climbing or a platform without authorisation
A loose item is above people and access below cannot be controlled
